title: test(lint): pin the dispatch-contract disarm by an undeclared same-named action, and state it in the docblock
body:
Fixes #17923

Clause-②: no

## What this is

`validateActionDispatchContract` goes silent for an action name when any same-named action in the stack declares no `execution`. That behaviour is deliberate and **stays as it is**. This PR adds pins for it and rewrites the `collectDeclaredContracts` docblock to explain the mechanism. **No logic change**: every changed line in `validate-action-dispatch-contract.ts` is a comment line, and the built JS and `.d.ts` are byte-identical to the base (see Changeset below).

## The mechanism, checked on the base

`collectDeclaredContracts` puts global and object-embedded actions into one flat name namespace. When an action declares nothing, `contractOf(a.execution) ?? 'none'` adds `'none'` to that name's contract set. Then `if (contracts.size !== 1) continue;` drops the name. So a missing declaration counts as a disagreeing one. I checked this at the claim's base `041c8cf62b` and again at this branch's base `70a2e752b8`. Between those two commits `packages/lint` has no diff.

## Changes

- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-dispatch-contract.test.ts` gets a new `describe` block with five tests. They share one stack builder: one view on `task` wires `recalc` as a bare string, and `invoice` is an object the view never resolves through.
  - CONTROL: a global `recalc` declared `aggregate` is refused (1 finding, at `views[0].list.bulkActions[0]`).
  - CONTROL: a same-named sibling that declares the SAME contract, on `task` and again on `invoice`, leaves that finding in place. So the silence comes from the sibling's missing declaration, not from a second declaration being there.
  - Disarm, three cases, each run beside the same stack without the sibling (1 finding):
    - an undeclared `recalc` embedded in `task` gives 0;
    - an undeclared `recalc` on the unrelated `invoice` gives 0;
    - an undeclared global `recalc` next to an object-embedded declaration gives 0.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-action-dispatch-contract.ts`: the `collectDeclaredContracts` docblock now says it directly:
  - absence counts as disagreement;
  - one undeclared same-named action anywhere in the flat namespace turns the rule off for that name, for every view that wires it;
  - declarations are not scoped by the view's object.

  It keeps the existing reasoning (zero false positives, silence as the safe direction, "undeclared is not defaulted"). It adds one point: treating an undeclared sibling as agreement would bring back that silent default through the sibling.

The third option from the review is **not** in this PR: scoping declarations by the view's object would change behaviour.

## Ablation: the pins can fail

- **Mutation:** `const declared = contractOf(a.execution) ?? 'none';` becomes `const declared = contractOf(a.execution); if (declared === undefined) return;`, which deletes the `'none'` arm.
- **How it was applied:** with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. On disk: anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `3be3e4678b42` to `2bcd771ce874`.
- **Restore:** with `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`. It was checked by blob hash against `HEAD:` plus an empty `git diff HEAD`, and a shell trap covers EXIT/INT/TERM.
- **No build leg:** the test imports the subject by relative path from `src/`, not through `exports`/`dist`.

| leg | tree | run | result |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| before the pins | `041c8cf62b` (claim base) | whole `@objectstack/lint` suite, mutated | 108 files, 4106 passed, 5 skipped. **No test fails**, which confirms the card's claim |
| after the pins | `4433ece870` (head) | `validate-action-dispatch-contract.test.ts`, mutated | **3 failed**, 16 passed: exactly the three disarm pins. Both controls and all 14 older tests stay green |
| restore | `4433ece870` | same file, from the committed state | 19 passed; blob `3be3e4678b42` equals `HEAD:`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty |

## Changeset: none (the `skip-changeset` route)

`@objectstack/lint` ships `files[]` = `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. It does not ship `src/**`.

- **Grep at the head, after a build, over those paths:**
  - the docblock phrases `ABSENCE COUNTS AS DISAGREEMENT`, `arriving through a sibling` and `undeclared is not defaulted` get **0** hits;
  - the positive controls hit: `action-dispatch-contract-mismatch` in 6 files and `collectDeclaredContracts` in 4.
- **Byte comparison:** I built the package with the rule file at base and at head. `index.js`, `index.cjs`, `runtime.js`, `runtime.cjs` and all four `.d.ts`/`.d.cts` files have identical sha256. Only the sourcemap line mappings move, and the maps carry no source text (`check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` green).
- **The test file** is not a tsup entry and ships nowhere.

So nothing in this PR reaches a consumer. It takes the `skip-changeset` route, and the seat applies that label.

## Verification (head `4433ece870`)

- **Tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 108 files, 4116 passed. That is the base's 4111 plus the 5 new tests. The base's 5 skips ran here because the lint `dist/` was built for this run.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run typecheck` exits 0. `check:test-typecheck` is OK, its ledger is unchanged, and `--listFiles` shows this test file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program with 0 errors against it.
- **ESLint, narrowed and proven:**
  - `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the two files: 2 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings;
  - `--print-config` resolves 6 and 5 rules for them, so neither file is ignored;
  - type-aware linting is not enabled (`parserOptions.project` and `projectService` are both null). So this diff cannot change the verdict for any file it does not touch. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 52 commands. `--ran` reconciles them as 50 run at exit 0, **2 NOT MEASURED**, and 0 unrun.
  - `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (prerequisite). It passed after building the `@objectstack/objectql` closure.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` both exit 3. They need the whole workspace built (`turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'`). The only package this diff touches has byte-identical JS and `.d.ts` output, and its build-config source change is comment-only. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs both on a fresh full build.
  - The three roster gates flagged for a `packages/` path also pass: `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.

## Acceptance notes

- The file header's section "What this rule refuses — and what it deliberately does not" still says only that the rule "says nothing about an action that declares NO `execution`". The claim limited this round to the `collectDeclaredContracts` docblock, so the header is unchanged. The docblock is where the mechanism is now stated.
- The branch was rebased from `041c8cf62b` onto `70a2e752b8` before its first non-empty push, because the gate derivation flagged the tree as stale. The push was a fast-forward from the empty-branch push; nothing was force-pushed.
